title: Dart extract_method_symbol bug
description:
Dart extract_method_symbol has a pre-existing bug: when static is the first child of method_signature, it gets picked as the inner signature
  node, causing child_by_field_name(name) to return None. Static methods inside classes are silently dropped from the index. This predates this
   task — worth filing as a follow-up.
root_cause: extract_method_symbol took .next() on method_signature children — for static members, the 'static' keyword is the first child, not the signature node, so child_by_field_name('name') returned None and the method was silently dropped.
